content:
Leah M: Quick design huddle: compact autoscale row updates. Need decisions on 1) min/max inline edit behavior, 2) SLO slider presets vs fine mode, 3) burst modal copy + CTA.

Theo R: Inline edit should accept typing, Enter to save, Esc to cancel. Arrow keys nudge by 1; Shift+arrow nudge by 10. Show inline validation if min>max.

Sam (FE): Agreed. We'll use numeric inputs (hidden spin buttons) with visible +/- steppers; arrow keys map to step attribute. For SLO, propose three preset chips (50/75/95) collapsed under "Presets" chevron, plus a "Fine" toggle to switch to 1% steps.

Nora (a11y): A11y notes: inputs need labels (can be visually hidden), steppers need aria-labels, slider must expose aria-valuenow/min/max. Popover needs aria-expanded and focus management. Announce validation errors via aria-live polite.

Leah M: Burst copy options: short and explicit. Draft: "Enable burst: +{n} GPUs for up to {t} minutes. Billed while active." CTA: "Enable burst (+{n}, {t}m)". Secondary: "Don't enable". Add link "How burst billing works."

Theo R: Also add an auto-revert checkbox in modal: "Auto-revert after burst period" w/ tooltip.

Sam (FE): Will prototype numeric inputs + presets popover and modal. Nora, can you provide a short ARIA checklist we can paste into the prototype?

Nora (a11y): Sure: 1) label inputs, 2) aria-valuenow/min/max on slider, 3) trap focus in modal, 4) role=status for cost estimate.

DesignBot: New figma frame: https://redwood.design/figma/compact-autoscale-v4 (uploaded by Leah M)

Leah M: Thanks team. Action items: Sam 1 prototype, Nora 1 a11y checklist, Theo 1 copy tweak. Closing thread after prototype review.
